steps.what: Identify emergency call location and immediate response instructions
Reach the emergency location and assess immediate hazards
Choose the appropriate emergency contact and exact location to report
Place the required emergency medical or security call
Describe the emergency and coordinate immediate assistance with responders
Respond to the emergency and assist patients under response instructions

tasks.design: Keep emergency response manual, using the existing {OTHER} hospital alarm system and {TELEPHONY}. Reading an alarm, travelling, checking hazards, making any necessary call, speaking with responders and assisting patients all remain; existing alarm runtime is not a labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task is an immediate physical response to changing conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing alarms and emergency contacts already support response; no additional tool removes an identified human action here.
tasks.still_hard: Hazards, patient movement and response priorities change on scene.
tasks.human_edge: The orderly notices physical danger and follows the response team's instructions.
tasks.altitude: Emergency response work and decision rights stay the same.

reach.learn: Safe patient handling and local emergency procedures

evidence.claim: Emergency assistance and scene coordination require human physical response; this is model knowledge. The digest's letter tools do not establish an emergency-response saving.

assumptions: Boundary is immediate response, not a separate investigation or incident-reporting assignment. Actual additional emergency calls are split from the conversation; no routine post-event record is invented.
The existing alarm system supplies call type and location where available. The orderly confirms missing or ambiguous location information in s1-s3. This data is not an assumed new clean feed.

The positive-time choice in s3 gates only initiating the specific emergency call in s4. It is the orderly's immediate decision, not a new remote approval delay. Some calls arrive already connected; that branch simply retains its existing response time.
A native-configuration check finds no repeated entry or dispatch handling to remove in this branch. No new system or ongoing upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Whether a separate incident report is required and who actually writes it
research_questions: Does direct observation reveal any actual repeat entry after emergency calls?

already_counted.description: Assess hazards, select the emergency contact and coordinate the response

incremental.description: No additional tool or upkeep introduced

approvals.approved_version: Specific emergency contact and scene location selected in s3; changed circumstances require a fresh choice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All one hundred hours remain, including the actual call and conversation. No record write, duplicate entry or real send is hidden inside physical response, and no new upkeep is added. Zero follows from the identified actions, not from applying a manual label to the whole occupation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Carry messages and documents between departments

steps.what: Receive the message or document and establish its intended destination
Check the exact document or message and authorised receiving department
Carry messages or documents to the receiving department
Deliver the checked message or document to the intended department recipient

tasks.design: Test native secure delivery in {DOCS} for messages and documents that the receiving department accepts digitally. Remove the corresponding walk in s3 and send that exact checked payload in s4; keep original-paper journeys and physical handover where required, with first digitisation and recipient verification counted separately as added work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Departments may rely on paper movement even when a usable digital copy would suffice.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document access and recipient-bound notifications can replace eligible interdepartmental deliveries without interpreting clinical content.
tasks.still_hard: Originals, unreadable scans, ambiguous recipients and urgent verbal clarification still require people.
tasks.human_edge: The orderly confirms what has to move, who may receive it and when physical delivery remains necessary.
tasks.altitude: Fewer eligible document-carrying trips, with the same authority over clinical content.

reach.task: Route clinical documents to the correct department
reach.learn: Document identity, destination checks and exception handling

evidence.claim: Secure document delivery can replace physical transport when a digital copy is accepted; this is model knowledge, not a measured hospital transport case.

assumptions: Boundary is transport and delivery of an existing payload, not composing it. The sending department already supplies the actual document or spoken message plus intended destination; the orderly confirms missing information in s1 and s2.

Test existing secure document configuration before custom code. For the central illustrative workload, digital eligibility removes forty-two of sixty travel hours and seven of ten physical handover hours. Eighteen travel and three handover hours remain for originals and physical exceptions. These are task estimates to validate, not an observed eligible proportion.

No digital file is free: six incremental orderly hours cover scanning paper, capturing a spoken message where suitable, checking page completeness and matching that digital version to the original. Failed scans revert to retained physical delivery. Additional maintenance is one hour.

The future sequence is receive, capture digital copy where needed, check the exact final copy and destination in s2, then dispatch s4. The eliminated s3 journey is not a machine send. S4 is the separate real send, with the same final-version check; altered copies or recipients require a fresh check.
No delivery log is introduced unless departments already require one. Recipient reading and sender composition are outside this transport boundary and earn no claimed saving.
unknowns: Whether secure delivery already replaces most trips
research_questions: Which observed journeys can be removed after counting first digitisation and failed delivery?

already_counted.description: Receive the payload and check final content identity and destination

incremental.description: First digitisation, completeness checks and digital recipient matching
Maintain delivery permissions and resolve failed notifications

approvals.approved_version: Exact original or completed digital copy and authorised department recipient checked in s2; any payload or destination change invalidates approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: forty-two travel hours and seven real handover hours removed, less six digitisation hours and one maintenance hour, gives 42. Cautious case: original-document requirements leave fifty of sixty travel hours and nine of ten handover hours; only eleven hours are removed while the full seven added hours remain, giving 4. Sender composition, receipt conversation and final checking are retained in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer patient call signals and determine needs

steps.what: Answer patient call signals and identify the calling bed or room
Reach the patient or establish the existing intercom conversation
Ask about the patient's need and observe the immediate situation
Determine the appropriate immediate assistance or nursing escalation

tasks.design: Keep the existing {OTHER} nurse-call system and personal response. The orderly identifies the location, makes contact, understands the need and selects assistance; the call-system signal and its existing runtime earn no labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: The call signal rarely explains the actual bedside need or danger.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing call signals and intercoms already support contact; no proposed configuration removes an identified repeated action.
tasks.still_hard: A patient may be distressed, unable to speak clearly or require an immediate physical assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The orderly listens and notices what a short call signal cannot convey.
tasks.altitude: No change to the week or decision rights for determining patient needs.

reach.task: Recognise when a patient's request needs nursing assessment
reach.learn: Local escalation criteria and communication with distressed patients

evidence.claim: Understanding a patient call may require direct observation and conversation; this is model knowledge. Letter explanation tools do not establish a bedside response saving.

assumptions: Boundary ends at determining the required assistance. Actual emergency calling and emergency response are explicitly decomposed in task 19359; they are not hidden in this conversation or counted again here.
The existing nurse-call system produces bed or room identifier and call state. The orderly confirms ambiguous location manually in s1 and s2. No automatically inferred patient need is assumed.

A native-configuration check retains the already used call and intercom functions. There is no new patient-request record, completion report or trailing handover document in this boundary; if an actual site requires one, its first capture must be observed and decomposed before assigning savings.
No additional software or ongoing upkeep is proposed. Existing automatic call-state recording is system runtime, not orderly effort.
unknowns: Whether any actual manual request entry accompanies calls
Which calls use an existing intercom
research_questions: Does observation reveal a real repeated record write or send beyond determining the patient's need?

already_counted.description: Listen, observe and determine immediate assistance

incremental.description: No additional tool or upkeep introduced

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All one hundred hours remain after separately identifying call acknowledgement, patient contact, conversation and the assistance decision. No actual record write or send is bundled into these steps. Existing automated call-state handling has no human time to remove and there is no added upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Physical emergency response and patient contact stay intact. Eligible document journeys can shrink only after counting first digitisation and checking the actual destination.
